title: CostRecord
description: One line of state/cost/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl in the content repo: what one pipeline run on the Anthropic API account cost, by the month it was recorded. record-cost writes it after the run from Claude Code's JSON result (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless.md, --output-format json; field shapes from SDKResultMessage and ModelUsage in https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript.md) and the run's work folder; budget-gate sums spend_usd over the month. Costs are Claude Code's client-side estimates, not billing data (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/cost-tracking.md).

run.description: The run's name, unique per run (the workflow passes the GitHub run id and attempt). A second record for the same run in the same month is not written.

recorded_at.description: UTC time the record was made, RFC 3339. Its month names the file.

complete.description: True only when the result file held a result message with subtype success and is_error false, and the Claude step itself succeeded. False when the Claude step failed, was stopped, or was cut off: the record then holds what is known.

incomplete_reason.description: Why the run is marked incomplete, in one plain sentence. Present only when complete is false.

budget_cap_usd.description: The hard per-run cap passed to Claude Code as --max-budget-usd.

total_cost_usd.description: total_cost_usd from the result message: the estimated cost of the whole run, subagents included. null when there was no readable result.

spend_usd.description: What the budget gate counts for this run. A complete run counts total_cost_usd. An incomplete run counts the larger of total_cost_usd and budget_cap_usd, because a cut-off run's result may be missing or zeroed and its real spend is unknown.

subtype.description: The result message's subtype: success, error_max_turns, error_during_execution, error_max_budget_usd, or error_max_structured_output_retries. null without a result.

permission_denials.description: How many tool calls the run's permission rules denied (the length of the result's permission_denials). A number above 0 means the workflow's allow list missed a command the runbook needed.

models.description: The result's modelUsage, by model id: tokens and estimated cost per model, subagents included. Empty without a result.

take_run.description: The run name queue take wrote into its claims (work/take.json run), or null when the run took nothing.

taken.description: Papers queue take handed the run, by kind of page and field.

pages.description: Pages the run built that pass the rule publish uses, by kind of page (full for depth full, quick for depth abstract) and field.
